 Clash Royale codes
 Here are the Clash Royale Store codes, creator codes, QR code rewards and Evolution Shard tips that players can use as of November 2026.
 Source: Clash Royale 
 By Yasemin Yaman 
 November 1, 2026 
 The 2026 season is underway in the arena, and players looking to power up their decks, unlock new card evolutions and speed up their chest cycle are searching for working Clash Royale codes. Many of them are hoping to find a free gem code. Below you’ll find what actually works this month and what you should know before you start redeeming.

 ANGRYFURNACE: Angry Furnace emoteFIREFIREFIRE: Wild Dragon emoteONEMAGICGIFTSHARETHEGOLDAre there free gem codes?
 To be honest, no. As of November 2026, there is no text code that hands out 1,000 gems. Supercell now distributes free cosmetics like banner decorations and emotes, along with resources, through its voucher link system.
 How to redeem Clash Royale Store codes
 Open Clash Royale on your device.
 Make sure you’re logged in to your Supercell ID.
 You’ll need your Supercell ID and the email address linked to it.
 Once logged in, open the Supercell Store page.
 Scroll down to the “Redeem Store Code” field.
 Enter or paste the codes one at a time, then tap Submit.
 Head back to the game to collect your gifts.
 What are Clash Royale creator codes?
 Creator codes work differently from Store codes because they don’t give you free items. They exist to support content creators involved with Clash Royale, which is why each one is named after its creator. Entering a code gives that creator a “boost,” meaning a small percentage of every purchase you make in the shop goes to the creator linked to the code you chose.

 How to use a creator code
 Open Clash Royale on your device.Go to the Shop tab and scroll down to the Creator Boost section.Tap “Enter Code.”Type or paste a code and tap OK.You’re now boosting the creator you picked.How to collect Evolution Shards
 If you want to evolve your cards, the Season Shop is a better bet than hunting for codes. Use the Season Tokens you earn from battles to buy at least one Wild Shard every month, since it’s the most valuable resource there.
